title: A mutual friend, E, saw a rectangular craft

tellings.quote: we both have a mutual friend. I I'll call her E. Um, and uh, she's the only person I know who's ever seen a rectangular craft, by the way, which is super interesting.

plain: A woman known only as E is said to have seen a rectangular flying craft. The researcher Deep Prasad tells Michels that E is a friend they both know and the only person he has ever met who saw a craft of that shape, which he finds "super interesting."
